name: Zerotsuka.~Another Storys2~
source:
"Tifa’s Route"
Tifa asks Saito to confirm whether her breasts are real. Saito agrees and starts fondling her chest. But soon, just touching isn’t enough, and Saito’s actions escalate… 

“I really want to do it… with Tifa…” 
“If Saito needs me that much, then…” 

"Luise’s Route"
After rescuing Tavitha, Saito and the group head to Tristain aboard the Eastern Ship. In her cabin, Luise is lost in thought when Saito suddenly hugs and kisses her. Their emotions get a bit too much for them to handle, and they… 

“I didn’t want to do this, but… I can’t help it.” 

Luise kisses Saito back. 

"Tavitha’s Route"
After rescuing Tavitha from the Tower of London, she offers to do whatever Saito wants as thanks. Saito takes her up on the offer and starts giving her some… interesting commands. 

“The only way I can repay Saito is by doing things like this…”

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ049149.html/]dlsite[/url]]
